experiments.title: Forest Atlas
experiments.description: A roomier forest with playback, sorting, density controls, and specimen inspection.

experiments.title: Forest Clearings
experiments.description: Groups the forest by asset class, age, temperament, and shared damage.

experiments.title: Market Terrain
experiments.description: Turns the forest into a risk-versus-growth scatter plot without giving up the ring glyphs.

experiments.title: Specimen Wall
experiments.description: Four maximum-detail specimens at a time; the direct precursor to the Arboretum.

experiments.title: Tree Ring Forest
experiments.description: The original grid: many small cross-sections and the earliest version of the visual grammar.

experiments.title: Tree Ring Poster
experiments.description: Large, highly detailed rings that introduced visible grain contours and specimen-scale inspection.

experiments.title: Portfolio Grove
experiments.description: Composes holdings into a grove and explores portfolio structure through the tree metaphor.

experiments.title: Animated Growth
experiments.description: Lets annual rings accumulate over time as a literal growth animation.

experiments.title: Living Grove
experiments.description: Translates financial ring histories into standing trees and a more literal forest landscape.

experiments.title: Standing Trees
experiments.description: Tests how ring-derived age, growth, and volatility might determine a tree's visible form.

experiments.title: Core Sample
experiments.description: Reframes annual financial history as a linear core sample for close comparison.

experiments.title: Climate Years
experiments.description: Finds years when drawdown scars synchronize across many living assets.

experiments.title: Master Chronology
experiments.description: Builds class-level reference trees and identifies years or assets that break agreement.

experiments.title: Fire Ecology
experiments.description: Asks whether qualifying crashes precede unusually strong regrowth.

experiments.title: Name That Tree
experiments.description: A guessing game that tests whether ring histories are distinctive enough to recognize.
